verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents editing across large codebases, including extra directories via `--include-directories`, and automated issue triage that labels and prioritizes GitHub issues, so it handles many items as an agent-driven task. It has no explicit documented bulk-operation feature, and scripted non-interactive runs are only a building block for user-built batch loops. Missing for 10: a documented first-class batch or bulk-operation capability, details on scale limits or atomicity across items, and independent hands-on confirmation of reliable multi-item changes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Issue Triage: Automated labeling and prioritization of GitHub issues based on content analysis
